summary: Derive a fresh state, diagnostics and dissipative reciprocal collision matrix.

capability: Derive a fresh state, diagnostics and dissipative reciprocal collision matrix.
operation: derive the effective multifluid plasma state
discovery.model: Effective local multi-fluid algebraic thermal state with externally supported background
discovery.geometry: B0 along z; fixed z thermal director at B0=0
discovery.boundary: Positive mass/density; B0 may be zero, beta then null; state is recreated independently of prior

identity.relation: Primary multi-fluid data to a freshly derived plasma state and reciprocal collision generator
identity.definition: rho=m*n; Q=sum(q*n); J=sum(q*n*v); P_parallel/perpendicular=rho*cs^2/gamma; omega_c=q*B0/m; omega_p=sqrt(n*q^2/(epsilon0*m)). Pair friction: acceleration_i=sum_j rate_ij*(dv_j-dv_i)-drag_i*dv_i, rho_i rate_ij=rho_j rate_ji.
identity.model: Effective local multi-fluid algebraic thermal state with externally supported background
identity.geometry: B0 along z; fixed z thermal director at B0=0
identity.coordinates: Cartesian x,y,z and ordered independent fluid species
identity.boundary: Positive mass/density; B0 may be zero, beta then null; state is recreated independently of prior
assumptions: Effective local algebraic thermal model; not full entropy evolution, CGL, kinetic physics, or the unmagnetized drift-directed Appendix A model.
Background sources and prescribed acceleration per mass have zero perturbation response. Gradients define a local/eikonal symbol, not an inhomogeneous global Maxwell-Gauss boundary solution.
The magnetic longitudinal pressure-divergence factor two is a phenomenological mirror correction; no universal kinetic mirror threshold or experimental accuracy claim.
Relativistic inertia uses d(gamma*v)/dv with noncovariant pressure and friction; no fully covariant thermodynamics claim is made.

inputs.name: species
inputs.description: Rows q,m,n,vx,vy,vz,cs_parallel,cs_perpendicular,eps_x,eps_y; one header line for text.
inputs.units: SI C,kg,m^-3,m/s,m^-1 by quantity; normalized units fixed by explicit c2,epsilon0 and B0
inputs.constraints: s>=1, m/n>0, cs>=0; None uses documented example rows; rows are independent fluids, including equal rows. Default normalized rows: [-1,1,4,0,0,0,0,0,0,0], [1,4,4,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]. Default SI rows: [-1.602e-19,9.109e-31,8.7e6,0,0,0,4.631e6,4.631e6,0,0], [1.602e-19,1.673e-27,8.7e6,0,0,0,9.360e4,9.360e4,0,0].

inputs.name: unit
inputs.constraints: normalized or si, without input conversion.

inputs.name: prior
inputs.description: Prior state accepted for call compatibility, never used as primary scientific input.
inputs.constraints: Every field is freshly derived; prior is not mutated.

inputs.name: cfg
inputs.description: Constants B0,c2,epsilon0,gammaTs; collision controls and classification.
inputs.units: B0 in T/SI or normalized; c2 speed squared; epsilon0 SI or normalized; rates s^-1 or normalized frequency
inputs.constraints: Only documented fields; c2/epsilon0/gammaTs>0. Explicit rates receiver i toward j, zero diagonal, nonnegative and rho reciprocal. drag_rates>=0. Legacy nue/nui light/heavy bath, nuei light-receiver cross-class, same-class nuee/nuii lower-rho receiver. Default mass classes normalized<=1 or SI<=9.1093837139e-31 kg; collision_classes explicit light/heavy (electron/ion aliases) overrides. These are numerical categories, not inferred species identities. Defaults normalized: B0=1,c2=1,epsilon0=1,gammaTs=1; SI: B0=8e-9 T,c2=(2.9979e8)^2,epsilon0=8.854e-12,gammaTs=5/3. All five legacy rates zero; absent explicit pair/drag rates derive from those zero controls. Default classes use the declared mass threshold.

outputs.name: species
outputs.description: Owned copy of all primary species inputs.
outputs.units: SI C,kg,m^-3,m/s,m^-1 by quantity; normalized units fixed by explicit c2,epsilon0 and B0

outputs.name: Deltas
outputs.constraints: Exactly zero at B0=0, fixed z director.

outputs.name: betasz
outputs.constraints: Undefined and returned None at B0=0, not a stale or invented zero.

outputs.name: Q0
outputs.constraints: May be nonzero under externally maintained background.

outputs.name: nu
outputs.description: Velocity collision generator: positive pair couplings and diagonal minus bath and outgoing-rate sum.
outputs.constraints: Row sum=-drag_rates; rho-weighted pairwise momentum conservation.

outputs.name: collision_rates
outputs.constraints: Nonnegative, zero diagonal, rho_i rate_ij=rho_j rate_ji; finite nonunderflowing momentum flux.

preconditions: Finite ten-column species data with positive mass/density and nonnegative sound speeds; all configured constants and rates satisfy their declared domains.
Caller chooses consistent SI or normalized quantities; unit selection labels data and selects defaults, and does not implicitly convert arrays.
supported: Fresh normalized/SI primary-state derivation, diagnostics, explicit and legacy reciprocal collision rates, repeated calls and zero magnetic field. No eigenspectrum or scan is calculated.
excluded: Effective local algebraic thermal model; not full entropy evolution, CGL, kinetic physics, or the unmagnetized drift-directed Appendix A model.
Background sources and prescribed acceleration per mass have zero perturbation response. Gradients define a local/eikonal symbol, not an inhomogeneous global Maxwell-Gauss boundary solution.
The magnetic longitudinal pressure-divergence factor two is a phenomenological mirror correction; no universal kinetic mirror threshold or experimental accuracy claim.
Relativistic inertia uses d(gamma*v)/dv with noncovariant pressure and friction; no fully covariant thermodynamics claim is made.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for invalid units, table shape, nonfinite quantities, physical signs, configuration, nonreciprocal rates or numerically unrepresentable derived state including momentum flux.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Native array conversion errors propagate. No file access or eigensolver is performed.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No state mapping returned on failure; no external state mutation or file side effect.

example.code:
from scirel.kinetic import initialize_plasma_state
s = initialize_plasma_state()
assert s['s'] == 2 and s['Q0'] == 0
example.expected: The default normalized state contained s=2 independent fluids and Q0=0.0.
